optionalFeatures: Charting or dashboard follow-ups built from the pivot output.
Assertions that the expected pivot table exists.
outcomes: Source data is modeled as one table before pivot logic depends on it.
Pivot tables are authored by name instead of fragile workbook surgery.
Readback confirms the resulting pivot structure.
requiredInputs: Persistence target when the workbook must be saved.
stdout.summary: Create one pivot-ready report flow from source data through named tables and pivot-table inspection.

commonPitfalls: Pivot authoring depends on stable source headers and range shapes.
Calculated fields and unsupported advanced pivot features may require later manual workbook refinement.
If the workflow grows visual layers, keep the pivot and chart responsibilities separate.

phases.label: Model Source Data
notes: Pivot work starts from explicit tabular semantics.
phases.objective: Create one table-backed source surface for later summarization.

phases.label: Author The Pivot
notes: Author the destination shape before adding later visual layers.
phases.objective: Create the pivot table and place it on a durable destination sheet.

phases.label: Inspect And Verify
notes: Use pivot readback to confirm the authored summary surface.
phases.objective: Read back pivot facts and broader workbook health after authoring.
